Verify accepted provider outcome before mail.message_sent and terminal receipt.

risks.risk: SMTP cannot supply universal exactly-once external delivery
risks.handling: At most one intended dispatch ownership, retained ambiguity and evidence-based reconcile. Stable Message-ID or job dedup alone cannot prove recipient delivery or suppress provider duplicates.

risks.risk: UIDVALIDITY reset cannot be resolved by UID or Message-ID alone
risks.evidence: WP-21 18754 and required old-UID/new-message distinction; current DTO retains Message-ID but no IMAP generation
risks.handling: Accept precise provenance matching policy; stable-message fingerprint/correlation is auxiliary and must not collapse distinct identical copies. Quarantine unresolved matches, preserve existing canonical references and expose recovery rather than invent certainty.

Persist possible-effect phase before send; lease expiry alone cannot justify resend. Conservatively preserve ambiguity after lost ACK, even when some pre-effect crash positions could not have delivered.

risks.evidence: JmapClient.compose destroys replaceDraftId at 345, MailCompose autosave at 468-473
risks.handling: Schedule references accepted canonical draft revision and retained immutable MIME/attachments, not mutable/replaced raw provider draft ID; synchronize autosave and schedule, document later-edit semantics.

risks.risk: Shared writer bypass and cross-window metadata
risks.evidence: MailService direct send/saveDraft and local-ipc broadcast to all windows
risks.handling: Apply accepted authority guard/subscription scope before cutover; preserve standalone explicitly and never silently fall back on shared outage. Inspection is not a proven deployed ACL vulnerability.

risks.evidence: WP-17/18/19/21 all propose contracts.ts/commands.ts/repository.ts; WP-21 two proposed migration paths and WP-19 provider intent/receipt
